title: Sand Grain Hits Earth at Light Speed

segments.text: This grain of sand could hit like a nuke.
It weighs about 1 milligram. Toss it at a window, and nothing happens.
But fire it at 1% of light speed, and it blasts like a kilogram of TNT.
At 99% of light speed? About 130 tons of TNT.
Now get it just 300 meters per second slower than light itself.
Boom. 15,000 tons of TNT, as strong as an atomic bomb.
It would explode high in the sky, in a blinding flash.
And at exactly light speed? The energy becomes infinite.
That's why nothing with mass can reach it… not even sand.
